close_reason: Added opportunistic retain-based eviction in enforce_for_delivery cache lookup block
description: The MtaStsEnforcer HashMap cache inserts one entry per unique recipient domain and never removes stale entries. The cache hit path uses .filter(|(_, valid_until)| Instant::now() < *valid_until) to skip expired entries, but never calls .remove() on them. On a server with long uptime sending to many distinct domains, the cache grows monotonically: expired entries accumulate as dead weight. Fix: periodically sweep the cache for expired entries (e.g., in load_fresh_policy after insert, or in a separate background task), or cap the cache size with LRU eviction.
title: MtaStsEnforcer cache never evicts expired entries — unbounded memory growth
